sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty selected parameters, including retention scale and liquid mobility. Gas permeability fixed at 3.75e-14 m2 and pore radius at 5.9e-6 m; reverse phase factor fixed at 1, evaporation A/E and inlet atmosphere also fixed, as are liquid latent contrast and transition width. Eight paired samples do not establish condensation-kinetic-range, dry-nucleation, all-parameter, hysteresis or permeability-range robustness. Earlier ensembles remain historical.
